title: Listen and Choose a Response — Weekend Plans

questions.stem: The concert tickets sold out in less than an hour.

options.A: I bought it an hour ago.
options.B: Maybe they'll add a second show later.
options.C: The concert hall is very old.
options.D: Yes, the shop is out of salt.

questions.explanation: Suggesting a new show is a hopeful reply to bad news. The distractors repeat 'hour', 'concert', and the sound of 'sold'.
questions.speaker: f4

audioSegments.text: The concert tickets sold out in less than an hour.
